headline: Bad Loans Worsen, Online Lending Industry Profits Eroded
summary: Profits of Indonesia's fintech lending industry fell 14.14% year on year as of September 2026, as bad loans worsened.
why: Peer-to-peer lending platforms in Indonesia are regulated by the financial regulator OJK and lend to consumers and small businesses, making credit quality central to their earnings.
original_headline: Kredit Macet Memburuk, Laba Industri Pinjol Tergerus
